Boston Dynamics taught their humanoid robot to row
The full body coordination of a rowing robot
caption:
Atlas takes on a Viking rowing challenge, coordinating its full body through every stroke.

Rowing is one of the hardest physical tasks to replicate in a machine. Each stroke requires the arms, torso, and legs to fire in perfect sequence while the body compensates for shifting momentum. Atlas pulls it off with a smoothness you wouldn't expect from a machine.

Boston Dynamics keeps pushing Atlas into moves that would test most people. This is their latest.
